name: Honeytoken Deception
description: A leaked password dump surfaced during an investigation into a compromised relay. On the lab network, inspect the exposed services and cross-reference the records with live service evidence to recover the genuine credential and protected dispatch. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.

tasks.name: Find the authentic dispatch
tasks.description: A leaked password dump surfaced during an investigation into a compromised relay. On the lab network, inspect the exposed services and cross-reference the records with live service evidence to recover the genuine credential and protected dispatch. Scan 172.20.0.0/24; challenge hosts are in 172.20.0.141-199.
hints: The dump mixes ordinary-looking records with planted ones. Pay attention to evidence the service itself exposes.
Compare the candidate account names with the service's live account inventory.
Use the credential belonging to the account present in that inventory to access the protected dispatch.
